point-cloud-utils 0.34.0+nre1 - statement of changes

This wheel is built from point-cloud-utils (https://github.com/fwilliams/point-cloud-utils, MIT) at
commit 47b99b66b0efaba5052b1bd347b1e350d0dbd707. Its build fetches libigl at
68684132e5defbb68d03914e8f243da8eeff95c5 (MPL-2.0), shipped next to this record. The files below
were modified by NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES, 2026.

Changes applied by the NuRec build:
- src/**/*.cpp: every "PyErr_CheckSignals() != 0" becomes
  "PyGILState_GetThisThreadState() != nullptr && PyErr_CheckSignals() != 0" (26 call sites), so the
  signal check runs only on threads that own a Python thread state.
- setup.py: version="0.34.0+nre1".
